user.title: ARP-Scan Device Tracker
user.description: Pick the network to scan for connected devices with ARP requests. More options are available after setup.

data_description.interface: Select a network interface from the list
data_description.network: Network range in CIDR notation (e.g., 192.168.1.0/24). Leave empty to auto-detect. Up to 1024 addresses (a /22) unless specific hosts are probed.
data_description.hosts: Probe only these IPs instead of scanning the network (for ZeroTier, WireGuard, Tailscale, etc.). Comma-separated list.

reconfigure.title: ARP-Scan Device Tracker
reconfigure.description: Change the network interface or range to scan.

data_description.interface: Select a network interface from the list
data_description.network: Network range in CIDR notation (e.g., 192.168.1.0/24). Leave empty to auto-detect. Up to 1024 addresses (a /22) unless specific hosts are probed.

error.cannot_detect_network: Could not detect network for the selected interface. Please specify the network range manually.
error.invalid_network: Enter a valid IPv4 network in CIDR notation, e.g. 192.168.1.0/24.
error.network_too_large: This network is too large to scan every 15 seconds. Enter a smaller range (at most 1024 addresses, a /22), or probe specific hosts.
error.invalid_ip: Enter IPv4 addresses separated by commas.

abort.reconfigure_successful: The interface and network were updated.

data_description.consider_home: How long to wait before marking a device as not home (10-1800 seconds)
data_description.resolve_hostnames: Look up device hostnames via reverse DNS (cached)
data_description.devices_enabled: Enable newly found device tracker entities by default. When disabled, new entities are added but disabled in the entity registry.
data_description.track_new_devices: Automatically create device tracker entities for newly discovered devices. When disabled, only previously known devices are tracked.
data_description.include: Only track devices with these IP addresses (comma-separated list)
data_description.exclude: Skip tracking devices with these IP addresses (comma-separated list)
data_description.hosts: Probe only these IPs instead of scanning the network (for ZeroTier, WireGuard, Tailscale, etc.). Comma-separated list.

error.invalid_ip: Enter IPv4 addresses separated by commas.
error.include_and_exclude: Use either Include IPs or Exclude IPs, not both.
error.network_too_large: The configured network is too large to scan every 15 seconds. Keep probing specific hosts, or reconfigure the integration with a smaller network.
